translations.web: But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
translations.bsb: But you who held fast to the LORD your God are alive to this day, every one of you.
translations.kjv: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
translations.asv: But ye that did cleave unto Jehovah your God are alive every one of you this day.
